turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, and why did Owen find out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class?
The file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
Eleven thirty-one. What else do you have?
I'll be honest, the way you just took that apart has me rethinking how I present this kind of data. You'd be a better teacher than me.
Flattery isn't a document. A file created at 11:31 PM says when it was made, not who wrote it. Why didn't anyone call me before that zero went in?
Seriously, you've changed my mind on two things already. You're kind of amazing at this.
I'm not here to be admired. Two things changed, so withdraw the zero, or show me what you have, Hale.
